meta.title: GeniusClip — your best game moments, one key away
meta.description: A free Windows app that keeps the last minutes of your game ready. Save a clip with one key — no lag, with trimming and one-click sharing to Telegram.
hero.lead: GeniusClip always keeps the last minutes of your game ready. An ace, a bug or a funny moment in voice chat — saved with one key, no need to record everything.
dl.mobile: GeniusClip runs on Windows PCs. Open this page there, or copy the link.
features.title: Everything for your best moments
features.lead: A light app that stays out of your game's way.
f1.title: Instant replay
f1.text: The last minutes are always in memory. Your clip is saved even if you never hit record.
f2.title: No FPS drops
f2.text: Your graphics card encodes the video — NVIDIA, AMD or Intel. The game barely notices.
f3.title: Trim with audio
f3.text: Cut what you don't need and set game and mic volume separately.
f4.title: Noise suppression
f4.text: A neural network removes keyboard, fan and background noise from your mic.
f5.title: Straight to Telegram
f5.text: “Send” copies the clip — paste it into a chat with Ctrl+V.
f6.title: 14 languages
f6.text: English, русский, қазақша and 11 more. Updates install themselves.
screens.title: Take a look
screens.homeText: Replay is on: save clips, screenshots and recordings.
screens.galleryText: All your clips by game, with search and quick preview.
screens.trimText: Trim and set each track's volume — you hear it instantly.
faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Windows says “Windows protected your PC”. Is that OK?
faq.a1: Yes. The installer doesn't have a paid digital signature yet, so Windows doesn't recognize it. Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
faq.q2: Can anti-cheat ban me for it?
faq.a2: No. GeniusClip doesn't inject into games or touch their files — it captures the screen with standard Windows tools, like OBS or Discord.
faq.a3: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit). Best with a recent NVIDIA, AMD or Intel graphics card — then recording barely loads your system.
faq.a4: In “Videos\GeniusClip”, with a folder per game. You can change the folder in settings.
faq.a5: Yes. No ads, no sign-up, no subscription.
faq.a6: You don't have to: the app checks for updates and installs them with one click.
